About the job

We are seeking a skilled IoT network engineer with B tech background to join our team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for deploying, managing, and maintaining IoT network infrastructures while ensuring reliable and secure connectivity for all devices and systems.

Key Responsibilities:

1. Work with various IoT protocols and technologies to support device connectivity and communication.
2. Troubleshoot and resolve network-related issues efficiently to ensure minimal downtime.
3. Deploy, configure, and manage IoT gateways, edge devices, and associated network components.
4. Implement and maintain security standards to protect IoT networks from vulnerabilities and threats.
5. Monitor network performance, identify potential issues, and optimize for maximum efficiency.
6. Develop and execute network automation solutions to streamline operational processes.
7. Collaborate with vendors and external partners to integrate new technologies into existing systems.
8. Install and configure access control devices and other IoT systems at customer sites, ensuring seamless operational integration.
9. Manage the content platform including content uploads, content scheduling/management, and handling audio/video configurations.
10. Provide technical support and documentation as needed.

About Highway Delite

Instagram page
Highway Delite is the first and only free travel app tailored for Indian highway travelers, aiming to make highway travel and road trips both enjoyable and safe. We are supported by the Government of Karnataka as a tourism startup and incubated at NSRCEL, IIM Bangalore. Our app equips highway travelers with essential information for their journeys, covering verified routes spanning over 10,000 kilometers, with ongoing expansions.
